spans.s:
स्मि स्म॑यते स्म॑य˚ति pp. स्मित (q.v.) smile, blush,
be proud or arrogant. — अव blush down (of the dawn). उद् smile up
(with pride). अभ्युद् & उप smile upon (acc.). प्र break out into a
laugh. वि be astounded or surprised by (instr., loc., or abl.);
 be
proud, boast of (intr.). — Cf. विस्मित.

स्मित a. smiling, expanded, blown;
 n. a smile.
स्मितपूर्व a. preceded by a smile.
स्मितोज्ज्वल a. shining with a smile (eye).
